title: Signature Error-Tinted Token Classification
description: A Signature original: tokens in code with known errors get a subtle tint shift, so problems are visible in the color itself before any squiggle renders. Tinting never obscures the base meaning. Signature-labeled; an original JAH design, not a public standard.

title: Signature Content-Derived Palettes

title: Signature All-State Contrast Audit
